items.title: Foreign holders of US Treasuries
items.note: Japan overtook China around 2019 and never gave the lead back. The Cayman line is mostly US hedge funds expressing positions through offshore vehicles, not Caribbean households.

items.title: Health spending, share of GDP, G7
items.note: The US spends roughly double the G7 median on health care as a share of GDP. Pair this with the life-expectancy chart for the headline policy contrast.

items.title: Federal dollars to VA-08
items.note: The Arlington / Alexandria district receives more federal money than 35 entire states. Sequestration in 2011 to 2015 carved a visible hole in the trajectory.

items.title: 10Y minus 2Y Treasury spread
items.note: The classic recession indicator. Stayed inverted from late 2022 through most of 2024, the longest inversion in modern history. Then dis-inverted without the recession showing up — yet.
